svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A shallow box round both pulleys: 566 x 316 x 60 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold a tray (bottom and sides) and a separate lid (top), so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: belt can be fitted and checked with the tray off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: 40 mm holes over the gearbox shaft and the spindle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom: 32 mm hole for the spindle foot; the union stays below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four hangers 25 x 3 flat bar, 50 tall, bolted to the top and to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the undersides of a gearbox member and a spindle member.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Speed sensor: on a bracket under the top, beside the driven pulley.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 6 mm clear of both pulleys and the belt all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no finger can reach a pulley through any opening.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Never run the machine with this guard off.
